podcast.title: Criticism (1959)
podcast.body: In 1959, popular music was critically described as "an orgy of gut-spilling, whimpering, and sobbing." This quote reflects the strong disdain some pundits held for the emotional and expressive styles prevalent in music at the time. "Popular music is an orgy of gut-spilling, whimpering, and sobbing."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Criticism (1964)
podcast.body: In 1964, popular music faced criticism as "intertikulat, childish, incoherent, and disgusting." This illustrates a continuing trend of dismissive and harsh judgments from older generations or traditional critics towards evolving musical forms and expressions. "Intertikulat, childish, incoherent, and disgusting."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
